findings.defect: The established display name is replaced with an unapproved alternative.
findings.rationale: 명품충 is explicitly established for this text-message display name as “Designer-Brand Junkie.”

findings.current:
“Because they trust me.”

“What?”

“They trust my instincts, and they trust my eye for people. That’s why I want to hold on to Jin Taekyung.”
findings.defect: The translation changes the subject from Choi trusting himself to unspecified others trusting him, inventing external Guild approval for his decision.
findings.rationale: 저를 믿으니까요 and the following repeated 믿습니다 are first-person statements about Choi’s confidence in his own instincts and judgment.
findings.replacement:
“Because I trust myself.”

“What?”

“I trust my instincts and my eye for people. That’s why I want to sign you, Mr. Jin Taekyung.”
findings.source:
“저를 믿으니까요.”

“네?”

“제 촉을 믿고, 사람 보는 눈을 믿습니다. 그래서 진태경 씨를 꼭 잡고 싶어요.”

findings.current: “Hey, HR. Process two resignations today. Kim Sangshik and Kim Sangho.”
findings.defect: The English makes the dismissals sound like voluntary resignations even though the Guild Master has just fired Kim Sangshik and orders both father and son removed.
findings.rationale: In context, 퇴사 처리 is an administrative order to terminate their employment, not a report that they chose to resign.
findings.replacement: “Hey, HR. Process two terminations today. Kim Sangshik and Kim Sangho.”
findings.source: “어, 인사팀장. 오늘 두 명 퇴사 처리 해. 김상식이랑 김상호.”

findings.current: For the next few days, Sopung Guild was in an uproar over the rare event of a father and son resigning at the same time.
findings.defect: The narration again characterizes the father and son as resigning voluntarily, obscuring the consequence of the Guild Master’s order.
findings.rationale: The preceding scene establishes that the Guild Master dismisses both men; the neutral 퇴사 cannot override that explicit context.
findings.replacement: For the next few days, Sopung Guild was in an uproar over the rare event of a father and son being forced out at the same time.
findings.source: 그 후, 며칠간 소풍 길드는 부자(父子) 동시 퇴사라는 보기 드문 사건으로 시끄러웠다.

findings.defect: The named spear technique is rendered with a different name from the established terminology.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is established in this block as “One Annihilation,” specifically the technique used to kill the Boss Zone monster in one blow.

findings.current: Dialect burst out of me before I knew it.
findings.defect: 방언 here means speaking in tongues, not a regional dialect; the mistranslation makes the punch line semantically incoherent.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is blurting out an ecstatic, quasi-religious stream of facts about Shin Saimdang after recognizing the high-denomination bills.
findings.replacement: I started speaking in tongues before I knew it.

findings.current: A roller coaster that dropped whenever the System disappeared…
findings.defect: The conditional fear that the System might disappear is recast as a recurring event, falsely implying that it has disappeared before.
findings.rationale: The conditional 사라지면 describes a feared future possibility, not something that repeatedly happens.
findings.replacement: A roller coaster that would plummet if the System disappeared…

findings.current: “Mrs. Kim is really excited now that her son’s home after so long.”
findings.defect: The established joking sobriquet 여사 is flattened into the ordinary marital title “Mrs.”
findings.rationale: 여사 is established as “Lady” when Taekyung jokingly refers to Kim Jeonghee.
findings.replacement: “Look at Lady Kim, all excited because her son’s home after so long.”
findings.source: “오랜만에 아들 왔다고 아주 신나셨네, 우리 김 여사.”

findings.current: “Our Mrs. Kim is starting again. I know how to eat boiled pork too, you know?”
findings.defect: The established joking sobriquet is again replaced with the ordinary title “Mrs.”
findings.rationale: 김 여사님 continues the established playful “Lady Kim” address.
findings.replacement: “There goes Lady Kim again. I know how to eat boiled pork too, you know?”
findings.source: “우리 김 여사님 또 시작이네. 나도 수육 먹을 줄 알거든?”

findings.current: “From you. You kept calling it in your sleep.”
findings.defect: The English incorrectly treats a person’s name as something Taekyung was “calling,” producing an unclear referent and unnatural meaning.
findings.rationale: 그 이름을 부르다 here means that Taekyung repeatedly called out or said Jin Wikyung’s name while asleep.
findings.replacement: “From you. You kept saying that name in your sleep.”
findings.source: ‘오빠한테. 아까 자면서 계속 그 이름을 부르더라고.’

summary: The block is broadly faithful, but contains one altered speaker-subject, a repeated false implication that two fired employees resigned voluntarily, one mistrendered named technique, one mistranslated idiom, a conditional event recast as recurring, and several established-term or localized wording defects.
